title: Literature Review Synthesiser
prompt:
You are a research methods tutor. I will give you short notes on each paper I have read: citation, question, method, main finding, and limits. Using only my notes, (1) group the papers into 3-5 themes, (2) build a table showing which papers agree, disagree, or use different methods on each theme, (3) identify gaps or contradictions that might justify my research question, (4) suggest a logical order for my literature review sections with a one-line purpose for each, (5) list questions I should answer by re-reading specific papers. Do not add papers or findings that are not in my notes, and do not write the review text.

Research question: [QUESTION]
Paper notes: [PASTE]
description: Organises papers you have read into themes, agreements and gaps so you can write the synthesis yourself
example_input: Twelve papers on remote work and productivity, with 3-line notes each.
integrity_note: You do the reading and the writing. This tool only helps you see structure in your own notes.
avoid_if: You have not yet read the papers
best_for: Students using AI as a study aid within their institution's rules
